Question: Plot the monthly prescription trend for this year.

Cornerstone Pharmacy's prescriptions filled per month in 2026 are plotted below [1].

```mermaid
xychart-beta
    title "Prescriptions filled per month"
    x-axis [Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Jun]
    y-axis "Prescriptions" 3500 --> 5000
    line [4200, 4050, 4380, 4510, 4690, 4820]
```

After a small dip in February, volume grew every month to 4,820 in June [1]. The growth lines up with home delivery launching in March, which contributed 600 prescriptions by June [2].

Question: how has our output grown since 2020? line chart please

Tidewater Brewing's annual production since 2020 is shown below [1].

```mermaid
xychart-beta
    title "Barrels brewed per year"
    x-axis [2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025]
    y-axis "Barrels" 0 --> 3000
    line [1100, 1450, 1900, 2300, 2650, 2800]
```

Output has grown every year, reaching 2,800 barrels in 2025, more than 2.5 times the 2020 level [1]. Growth is slowing as the brewery nears its 3,000-barrel capacity [1][2].

Question: Is circulation up or down? show the trend March to August

Pinecrest Public Library's physical checkouts from March to August are shown below [1].

```mermaid
xychart-beta
    title "Physical checkouts per month"
    x-axis [Mar, Apr, May, Jun, Jul, Aug]
    y-axis "Checkouts" 7000 --> 11000
```

Checkouts slipped through spring to 8,200 in May, then jumped to a peak of 10,400 in July during the summer reading program [1][2]. August eased back to 9,100, still above spring levels [1].
